content.comment_body: I'm unable to establish an HTTPS connection to log in to the [product_name] webpage. I use Chrome and have installed the root certificate. Is there something else I need to configure in [product_name]...? HTTPS mode is already enabled in the software settings, but testing within my LAN still doesn't allow me to log in securely via HTTPS.

Now I am able to log in to the [product_name] webpage using HTTPS successfully. The issue was resolved after I imported the root certificate directly within Chrome's settings menu. Previously, I installed the certificate elsewhere, which didn't work.

analysis.insight_summary: The user originally faced difficulties accessing the [product_name] web interface over HTTPS with Chrome, even after enabling HTTPS in the associated configuration and installing the root certificate. The issue was traced to the root certificate not being imported correctly in Chrome's settings. Once the certificate was imported to the proper location, secure access was achieved, emphasizing the need for correct certificate management.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects seamless and secure (HTTPS) access to the [product_name] web interface once the relevant instructions for enabling HTTPS and installing the root certificate have been properly followed.
